Country.evidence_source:
Text: "Male Sample
Barlett's test of sphericity, χ^2(45) = 2241.78, p < .001, and the KMO measure of sampling adequacy, KMO = .93, exceeded minimum standards that should be passed before EFA can be conducted. The results of the EFA pointed to the existence of a single factor with λ = 5.67 and explaining 56.9% of the total item variance. All item-factor loadings in the component matrix were very good (≥.63; see Table 1)."

section_summary.extract_value: This section, headed "Male Sample," reports exploratory factor analysis (EFA) results for a male-only sample: Bartlett's test of sphericity χ^2(45) = 2241.78, p < .001, KMO = .93, a single factor (λ = 5.67) explaining 56.9% of variance, and item loadings ≥ .63 (see Table 1). No sample size, demographic (age, race, education), BMI information, assessment instruments (BAS/BAS-2), correlations with BMI, survey method, or study numbering are provided in this text.
